page.overview:
What is Venipede?

Venipede is a small armored arthropod Pokémon that resembles a centipede. Its body is reddish magenta and green. It has black markings on its neck, shoulders and antennae. It has a dome-shaped segment on its upper body, and its lower body is segmented. Venipede has four pairs of black legs and two tails. It has large squinted yellow eyes with slit black pupils, giving it an ill-tempered appearance.

Venipede is a very aggressive Pokémon that will use its venom to paralyze its predators. A voracious predator, Venipede will consume whatever prey it can swallow whole without knowing the outcome. It is said to be a close relative of Skorupi and Sizzlipede; however, once Venipede crosses paths with a Sizzlipede, a huge fight will ensue.

Venipede evolves into Whirlipede starting at level 22 and then evolves into Scolipede starting at level 30.
